categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Cowin Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in molecular diagnostics, focusing on core molecular detection technologies including raw material enzymes, nucleic acid preservation reagents, nucleic acid extraction and purification reagents, and molecular diagnostic kits. The company also provides molecular detection services and technology services, with a business layout covering core raw material enzymes, reagent kits, and detection services. It has expanded into digestive tract diseases and respiratory infectious disease screening and diagnosis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed six core technology platforms: raw material enzymes, nucleic acid preservation, nucleic acid extraction and purification, quantitative fluorescent PCR, gene sequencing, and nucleic acid mass spectrometry. It employs advanced protein engineering, fermentation purification, seamless cloning, and freeze-drying technologies. Production is managed under ISO13485:2016 quality management system with automated equipment and ERP systems ensuring traceability and quality control throughout the manufacturing process.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include molecular diagnostic reagent manufacturers, research institutions, hospitals, third-party medical laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, CROs, and industrial clients. The company serves domestic and international markets, providing products and services for clinical diagnostics, scientific research, and public health screening, especially in digestive and respiratory diseases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with marketing centers in major regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Greater Bay Area, and expanding coverage in Fujian, Sichuan, Chongqing, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, and Northeast China. It has established overseas marketing centers in the US, Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Africa, with subsidiaries and sales offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Wuhan, and Taizhou.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cowin Biotech operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the molecular diagnostics supply chain, producing core raw material enzymes and reagents, as well as diagnostic kits. It also provides downstream molecular detection services, integrating the full value chain from raw materials to testing services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high-intensity R&D investment focused on developing rapid, high-sensitivity, and anti-inhibition raw material enzymes, expanding Class III in vitro diagnostic reagent products, and accelerating screening and diagnosis technologies for digestive and respiratory diseases. It aims to enhance automation, digital marketing, and global market penetration, supported by a strong R&D team led by industry experts and continuous patent and product registration efforts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of molecular diagnostic reagents and kits, molecular detection services for medical and research institutions, and technology services including sequencing platforms. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales complemented by distributor channels, with contracts signed for product supply and service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants like Thermo Fisher Scientific, Qiagen, Roche Diagnostics, and domestic peers such as BGI, Daan Gene, and Sanofi. Cowin Biotech positions itself as a leading domestic innovator with comprehensive upstream technology capabilities, breaking foreign monopolies in core raw materials and expanding into integrated molecular diagnostics solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 125.9 million, a 26.54% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 157.2 million, worsening by 86.25%. R&D investment increased by 12.43% to RMB 99.2 million, accounting for 78.84% of revenue. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.62 billion and employs 833 staff, including 230 in R&D. Despite recent financial losses, the company maintains a strong focus on innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cowin Biotech offers a unique integrated molecular diagnostics solution combining self-developed core raw material enzymes, nucleic acid preservation and extraction reagents, diagnostic kits, and testing services. Its products match or exceed imported alternatives in performance and cost-effectiveness, supported by a robust intellectual property portfolio and participation in national standards development. The company emphasizes high-quality, customizable solutions, rapid detection technologies, and comprehensive customer service to meet diverse clinical and research needs.
